recipe.name: hb1603_survey_echogram_pyramid
recipe.description: The whole HB1603 cruise as an EchogramGL pyramid: per-file MVBS on depth, 18 and 38 kHz, seabed masked by the phase-aware picker.

nodes.label: inputs.file_time_start
nodes.description: Start of the NCEI catalogue query, an inclusive ISO UTC datetime such as "2016-07-25T20:58". Every file overlapping the window is fetched.

nodes.label: inputs.file_time_end
nodes.description: End of the NCEI catalogue query, an inclusive ISO UTC datetime such as "2016-07-25T21:45". Every file overlapping the window is fetched.

nodes.label: inputs.cal_input_folder
nodes.description: Folder of manufacturer calibration files (.cal for EK60, .xml for EK80), a local path or a gs:// URL.

nodes.label: inputs.calibration_output_dir
nodes.description: Root folder the calibration artifacts are written under.

nodes.label: inputs.crop_max_range_m
nodes.description: Range ceiling in metres; samples beyond it are dropped even if they hold data. Changing it recomputes the whole survey Sv.

nodes.label: inputs.viewer_crop_max_range_m
nodes.description: Range ceiling of the viewer picture, in metres. Separate from crop_max_range_m, so the shared survey Sv keeps its own crop.

nodes.label: inputs.viewer_grid_max_depth
nodes.description: Deepest depth the viewer bins cover, as a length string such as "3010m". It must clear viewer_crop_max_range_m plus the transducer depth, or the deepest samples are dropped.

nodes.label: inputs.cruise_name
nodes.description: Cruise name searched for in the NCEI catalogue, such as "HB1603".

nodes.label: inputs.cruise_id
nodes.description: Cruise identifier, such as "HB1603", recorded in every generated single-channel calibration file so it stays traceable to the survey.

nodes.label: inputs.record_author
nodes.description: Name recorded as the author of every generated single-channel calibration file.

nodes.label: inputs.max_scan_bytes
nodes.description: Most leading bytes read from each raw file to find its channel configuration. The default, 1 MiB, settles every HB1603 file in one small read.

nodes.label: inputs.match_tolerances
nodes.description: Per-field tolerances for matching a raw channel to a calibration file (Hz, W, or s), merged over exact defaults. The default widens transmit_power to 1001 W.

nodes.label: inputs.sonar_model
nodes.description: Echosounder model as echopype names it, such as "EK60" or "EK80".

nodes.label: inputs.seabed_channel
nodes.description: Channel the seabed is picked on, as a channel label or a frequency in kHz such as "38". 38 kHz reaches the bottom everywhere on HB1603.

nodes.label: inputs.seabed_max_slope_deg
nodes.description: Maximum plausible seabed slope, in degrees; with the distance between pings it sets how far the line may move per ping at ordinary cost. Use 45 for canyon terrain.

nodes.label: inputs.seabed_max_gap_s
nodes.description: Interior gaps in the detected seabed line up to this many seconds are interpolated. Longer gaps, and the ends of a file, follow the missing-seabed setting.

nodes.label: inputs.seafloor_buffer_m
nodes.description: Height above the seabed line, in metres, that is also masked, to drop the bottom echo and detection error.

nodes.label: inputs.seabed_line
nodes.description: "leading_edge" masks from the top of the seabed echo; "integration" masks from the slope-corrected line above it, which clears more on steep walls.

nodes.label: inputs.surface_depth_m
nodes.description: Range from the transducer, in metres, above which samples are masked, to remove the transmit pulse and ringdown.

nodes.label: inputs.frequencies_to_mask
nodes.description: Nominal channel frequencies in kHz to blank, such as [70, 120, 200]; every sample on those channels is masked. An empty list keeps every channel.

nodes.label: inputs.noise_range_sample_num
nodes.description: Range samples per bin for the background noise estimate.

nodes.label: inputs.noise_ping_num
nodes.description: Pings per bin for the background noise estimate.

nodes.label: inputs.noise_snr_threshold
nodes.description: Samples whose noise-corrected Sv is less than this above the noise estimate are masked, as a dB string such as "3.0dB". Raise it for a cleaner, shallower picture.

nodes.label: inputs.noise_background_max
nodes.description: Ceiling on the background noise estimate, as a dB string such as "-125dB". Null leaves it unbounded.

nodes.label: inputs.range_bin
nodes.description: Depth bin height of the MVBS grid, as a length string such as "2m". The sparse-bin mask uses the same bin.

nodes.label: inputs.ping_time_bin
nodes.description: Ping-time bin width of the MVBS grid, as a duration string such as "10s". The sparse-bin mask uses the same bin.

nodes.label: inputs.range_var
nodes.description: Variable the bins are built on: "depth" (below the surface, shared across files and channels) or "echo_range" (from the transducer face). Keep "depth" to layer this store with the analysis store.

nodes.label: inputs.nan_threshold
nodes.description: Fraction of NaN samples (0 to 1) above which the sparse-bin mask drops a bin.

nodes.label: inputs.viewer_chunk_ping_time
nodes.description: Ping-time chunk size of the survey MVBS store; the pyramid build reads it in segments, so a few chunks per segment suits it.

nodes.label: inputs.pyramid_range_var
nodes.description: Vertical coordinate of the pyramid store: "depth" for a gridded product, "echo_range" for full-resolution Sv, where depth carries heave.

nodes.label: inputs.pyramid_levels
nodes.description: Pyramid levels to build, halving the column axis each time; eight reduce it by 128 at the coarsest.

nodes.label: inputs.pyramid_segment_columns
nodes.description: Rough segment size in columns, rounded down onto the pyramid's grid. Each segment is held in memory while it builds, about 1.7 GiB at the default.

nodes.label: inputs.pyramid_aggregation
nodes.description: How columns are merged: "linear_mean" averages in linear space, right for biomass; "max" keeps a single strong target a mean would dilute.
Query an NCEI acoustic data catalog for file listings within a time window. Returns a list of result records (file metadata), not the files themselves.

params.name: file_time_start
params.description: ISO 8601 start of window, e.g. '2016-07-25T20:58'

params.name: file_time_end
params.description: ISO 8601 end of window

params.name: filters
params.description: Key-value filters applied to NCEI metadata (e.g. CRUISE_NAME)

params.name: file_names
params.description: Keep only these files, matched on the D{date}-T{time} stamp in the name. A name the query did not return is an error. Empty keeps everything.

outputs.name: ncei_results
outputs.description: List of NCEI file metadata records (dicts) matching the query

outputs.name: query_label
outputs.description: Readable, folder-safe slug derived from the query parameters. Intended to be passed to download_ncei_data so that each query writes into its own subfolder under output_dir.

outputs.name: raw_urls
outputs.description: Public HTTPS URL of each record's .raw object, in record order. Map over it for steps that read files in place, such as read_raw_file_config with max_scan_bytes.

nodes.description: Read one raw file's channel configuration from its datagram headers. Map it over the raw file paths and collect the results with record_raw_file_configs.

params.name: raw_file_path
params.description: One .raw file, as a local path or a remote URL. Normally wired to ${_item}.

params.name: verify_start_time
params.description: If true, also read EK80 files in full to verify metadata_start_time, which is slower. The default single pass scan is enough for channel configuration.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Print per-file progress. Set false on a long fan-out to keep the log readable.

params.name: max_scan_bytes
params.description: Most leading bytes of a remote EK60 or EK80 file to read instead of the whole file, in bytes. Unset reads whole files. Around 1 MiB suits EK60; FM EK80 needs tens of MiB. Too low only costs a whole-file read.

outputs.name: file_config
outputs.description: This file's channel configuration: filename, metadata_start_time, and one entry per channel. Null when the instrument type cannot be detected, and record_raw_file_configs drops those entries.

nodes.description: Collect per-file channel configurations into raw_file_configs/raw_file_configs.yaml under the calibration output directory. Use collect on the scan step's file_config output.

inputs.name: file_configs
inputs.description: The collected per-file configurations, normally wired to the mapped read_raw_file_config step's file_config output. Null entries are dropped.

params.name: output_base
params.description: Root directory the calibration artifacts are written under. Normally wired to initial_setup's calibration_output_dir.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Print a summary of what was recorded.

outputs.name: raw_file_configs
outputs.description: The saved configurations, sorted by metadata_start_time. Pass to build_calibration_mapping so it need not re-read them from disk.

outputs.name: frequencies
outputs.description: Sorted unique channel frequencies in Hz. Sets the channel order for EK60 (.cal) calibration data, and is optional for EK80.

outputs.name: raw_configs_path
outputs.description: Full path of the raw_file_configs.yaml that was written. Wire it into build_calibration_mapping for the ordering dependency.

nodes.description: Convert manufacturer calibration files (EK60 .cal or EK80 .xml) to standardized single-channel .yaml files under single_channel_calibration_files/. Skipped when the manufacturer files are unchanged.

inputs.name: frequencies
inputs.description: Unique channel frequencies in Hz, normally from record_raw_file_configs. Sets the channel order for EK60 (.cal) data and is optional for EK80. Recovered from the saved raw_file_configs.yaml when omitted.

params.name: cal_input_folder
params.description: Folder of manufacturer calibration files (.cal for EK60, .xml for EK80), local or a remote URL.

params.name: output_base
params.description: Root directory the calibration artifacts are written under. Normally wired to initial_setup's calibration_output_dir.

params.name: cruise_id
params.description: Cruise identifier recorded in every generated single-channel file (e.g. "HB2407"), so a standardized file stays traceable to the survey it came from.

params.name: record_author
params.description: Name recorded as the author of every generated single-channel file. Not used in any calculation.

params.name: short_filenames
params.description: Use compact names for the generated single-channel files. Set false for longer, more descriptive names.

params.name: overwrite
params.description: Re-parse and rewrite even when the sidecar says the existing files are current, forcing a clean rebuild of the single-channel folder.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Print the parsed parameters and the files written.

params.name: override_channels
params.description: Write these channels as the single-channel files instead of parsing the manufacturer files. Same shape as the single_channel_data output: omit an entry to discard that channel, and edit values in place to correct them.

outputs.name: single_channel_dir
outputs.description: Folder the single-channel files were written to. Wire it into build_calibration_mapping for the ordering dependency.

outputs.name: channel_count
outputs.description: Number of single-channel calibration files in that folder.

outputs.name: skipped
outputs.description: True when the existing files were reused because the manufacturer files had not changed.

outputs.name: single_channel_data
outputs.description: The standardized channels as data: {"channels": [...]}, one entry per single-channel file, for review without reading the folder.

nodes.description: Match each raw channel to its calibration data and save the mapping files under mapping_files/. Mark the step regenerate: always in a recipe.

inputs.name: raw_file_configs
inputs.description: The raw file configurations to map, normally from record_raw_file_configs. Read from the saved raw_file_configs.yaml under output_base when omitted.

params.name: output_base
params.description: Root directory the calibration artifacts are written under. Normally wired to initial_setup's calibration_output_dir.

params.name: single_channel_dir
params.description: Folder of standardized single-channel files. Defaults to single_channel_calibration_files/ under output_base. Wire it to the standardization step's single_channel_dir output.

params.name: raw_configs_path
params.description: Path of the saved raw_file_configs.yaml. Defaults to raw_file_configs/raw_file_configs.yaml under output_base, and is only consulted when raw_file_configs is not supplied.

params.name: conflict_resolution
params.description: What to do when one raw channel matches several calibration files. "error" (default) lists the conflicts and stops. "interactive" prompts on the terminal. "report" returns them on the conflicts output and writes no mapping.

params.name: calibration_choices
params.description: Maps a conflict id from a previous run's conflicts output to a choice: the key to keep; a list of keys, or {"average": [keys]}, to average; or {"merge": [items]} to merge FM calibrations EK80 style, an item being a key or an average.

params.name: tolerances
params.description: Per-field match tolerances, merged over the defaults (1 Hz for the frequencies, 1 W for transmit_power, 1e-6 s for transmit_duration_nominal). Widening one applies a calibration measured at a different setting.

params.name: unmapped_channels
params.description: The unmapped_channels policy, "warn" or "error", of the step that extracts calibration parameters from this mapping. Only labels the provenance report; unset says the outcome is decided downstream.

params.name: cruise_id
params.description: Recorded in the provenance report when given.

params.name: record_author
params.description: Recorded as the author of any record averaged or merged while resolving conflicts. When omitted, the combined calibrations' author is kept if they share one.

params.name: keep_unused
params.description: Move calibration files no raw channel matched into unused_calibration_files/ instead of deleting them. They are the evidence when a channel comes out unmapped.

params.name: short_filenames
params.description: Use compact calibration keys in the returned dictionaries and for averaged and merged records. Match the setting the single-channel files were written with.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Print the mapping summary, preview, and verification results.

outputs.name: mapping_dict
outputs.description: Maps each raw file's channels to their calibration key, keyed by filename then channel_id. Feed to extract_standardized_cal_params.

outputs.name: calibration_dict
outputs.description: Parsed standardized calibration data keyed by calibration key. Holds the values themselves. Feed to extract_standardized_cal_params.

outputs.name: missing_params
outputs.description: Calibration keys mapped to the required parameters they are missing. An empty dict means every required parameter is present.

outputs.name: unused_files
outputs.description: Names of single-channel calibration files the mapping does not reference, including ones this run moved aside. Non-empty means a channel may have gone unmapped.

outputs.name: provenance
outputs.description: Per-channel account of what calibration was applied over which stretch of the cruise, and why, as time segments with their settings and outcome. Also written to mapping_files/calibration_provenance.yaml.

outputs.name: provenance_path
outputs.description: Where the provenance report was written as YAML, under mapping_files/ in output_base.

outputs.name: conflicts
outputs.description: Unresolved multiple-match conflicts, keyed by conflict id; only filled under conflict_resolution "report". Non-empty means no mapping was written: pass choices as calibration_choices and run again.

outputs.name: single_channel_data
outputs.description: {"channels": [...]}, the standardized channels the mapping was built from plus any averaged or merged records. Pass this to save_calibration_archive once an average or merge has been chosen.

nodes.description: Open raw echosounder files with echopype and write each one to an intermediate store. Returns the store paths, or in-memory EchoData objects when intermediate_format is "none".

inputs.name: raw_file_paths
inputs.description: Paths to .raw files to open, local or remote URLs such as gs://bucket/survey/file.raw. Remote files are copied locally one at a time and never modified.

params.name: sonar_model
params.description: Sonar model string recognized by echopype (e.g. 'EK60', 'EK80')

params.name: include_bot
params.description: Include bottom-detection (.bot) data if available

params.name: intermediate_format
params.description: Store format written between reading and combining. "netcdf" (default, recommended) writes temporary .nc files. "none" keeps everything in memory. "zarr" writes zarr stores, which can live on a gs:// temp dir.

params.name: use_swap
params.description: Whether echopype swaps data to disk while reading. "auto" (default) swaps a file whose expanded data would exceed about 40% of total RAM.

outputs.name: raw_stores
outputs.description: Store path strings (zarr/netcdf) written to exe_temp/data, or in-memory EchoData objects when intermediate_format is "none".

nodes.description: Combine the per-file stores or EchoData objects from read_raw_files into one EchoData object. Mark the step checkpoint: always so the combined output is written once and reused.

inputs.name: raw_stores
inputs.description: Store paths (zarr/netcdf strings) or in-memory EchoData objects

params.name: ping_time_chunk
params.description: Chunk length along ping_time for the combined EchoData and its checkpoint, in pings. Larger values write faster to gs:// but use more memory; try 2000 to 4000 for bucket caches.

outputs.name: echodata
outputs.description: Combined echopype EchoData object

nodes.description: Extract calibration parameters (gain, sa-correction, EBA) and environmental parameters (sound speed, absorption) from standardized calibration files, cross-referenced against the EchoData object for channel alignment.

inputs.name: calibration_dict
inputs.description: Parsed standardized calibration data keyed by calibration key, from generate_standardized_cal_mapping. Holds the values themselves.

inputs.name: mapping_dict
inputs.description: Raw channel to calibration key mapping, from generate_standardized_cal_mapping. Says which entry of calibration_dict belongs to each channel of each file.

inputs.name: echodata
inputs.description: EchoData whose channels the outputs are keyed by, normally from combine_raw_files, so they pass straight to compute_sv.

params.name: raw_file_path
params.description: Raw file whose mapping to use, matched by basename. Wire to ${_item} in a per-file chain. Unset uses the first file in the survey, which suits whole-survey recipes.

params.name: unmapped_channels
params.description: What to do with a channel no calibration file matched. "warn" (default) reports it and uses the values the raw file records. "error" stops the run.

params.name: output_logs_folder
params.description: Where the fallback writes its calibration flags. Unset uses a temporary folder.

params.name: waveform_mode
params.description: The waveform_mode compute_sv uses, "CW" or "BB". Selects which beam group's channels are extracted, for EK80 files mixing CW and FM. Unset uses the first beam group.

params.name: encode_mode
params.description: The encode_mode the compute_sv step passes to echopype, "complex" or "power". Set it together with waveform_mode, or leave both unset.

outputs.name: cal_params
outputs.description: Calibration parameters (gain_correction, sa_correction, EBA, beam widths and angle offsets), one value per channel, or per channel and frequency for FM calibrations.

outputs.name: env_params
outputs.description: Environmental parameters keyed by channel (sound_speed, sound_absorption)

outputs.name: other_params
outputs.description: Other calibration metadata by channel and source file. Its unmapped_channels entry names channels that fell back to the raw file's own values; empty when the mapping covered every channel.

nodes.description: Compute volume backscattering strength (Sv) from raw EchoData, applying cal_params and env_params when given and the raw file's own values otherwise.

inputs.name: echodata
inputs.description: Raw EchoData to calibrate, normally the single survey-wide object from combine_raw_files.

inputs.name: cal_params
inputs.description: Optional calibration parameter overrides. When null, echopype uses values from the raw file.

inputs.name: env_params
inputs.description: Optional environmental parameter overrides. When null, echopype uses values from the raw file.

outputs.name: ds_Sv
outputs.description: xarray Dataset containing Sv variable and ping_time, range_sample coordinates

nodes.description: Compute per-ping transducer depth in metres below the water surface from the EK Platform group, for feeding ``ep_add_depth`` as its ``depth_offset``. Use it instead of ``use_platform_vertical_offsets``, which gets the sign wrong.

inputs.name: ds_Sv
inputs.description: Calibrated Sv dataset supplying the target ``ping_time`` coordinate.

inputs.name: echodata
inputs.description: Source EchoData supplying the Platform group.

params.name: datum_correction_m
params.description: Metres added to the static offset when it is measured from a hull datum rather than the waterline. Positive pushes the transducer deeper. The default 0.0 takes the recorded offset as waterline referenced.

params.name: use_heave
params.description: Add the per-ping ``vertical_offset`` (heave) term. False holds the static keel depth on every ping. Without usable heave the step says so and uses the static depth.

params.name: heave_sign
params.description: Sign applied to ``vertical_offset`` (1.0 or -1.0). The default was verified on HB2407 (EK80); check it on a new vessel or instrument setup.

params.name: interp_method
params.description: Interpolation used to put heave on ping_time, such as "linear" (default) or "nearest".

outputs.name: transducer_depth
outputs.description: Transducer depth in metres below the surface on ds_Sv's ping_time. Wire it into ``ep_add_depth``'s ``depth_offset``. Attributes record where the value came from.

nodes.description: Add a ``depth`` variable, in metres below the surface, to an Sv Dataset using echopype. Existing variables, including ``echo_range``, are kept.

inputs.name: ds_Sv
inputs.description: Calibrated Sv dataset (typically from compute_sv).

inputs.name: echodata
inputs.description: Source EchoData. Required when any of ``use_platform_vertical_offsets``, ``use_platform_angles``, or ``use_beam_angles`` is true.

params.name: depth_offset
params.description: Transducer depth in metres, as a constant or a per-ping DataArray such as ``compute_transducer_depth``'s output. When set, takes precedence over Platform vertical offsets.

params.name: tilt
params.description: Constant transducer tilt; 0 corresponds to a vertically-pointing transducer. When set, takes precedence over Platform/Beam angles.

params.name: downward
params.description: True when transducers point downward (typical hull-mounted).

params.name: use_platform_vertical_offsets
params.description: Use Echodata Platform group vertical offsets to compute transducer depth. EK60/EK80 only. Ignored when ``depth_offset`` is set.

params.name: use_platform_angles
params.description: Use Echodata Platform group angles to compute echo_range scaling. EK60/EK80 only. Cannot be combined with ``use_beam_angles``.

params.name: use_beam_angles
params.description: Use Echodata Beam group angles to compute echo_range scaling. EK60/EK80 only. Cannot be combined with ``use_platform_angles``.

outputs.name: ds_Sv
outputs.description: Input Sv dataset with an added ``depth`` variable.

nodes.description: Trim the deep range samples that hold no data after seafloor masking. Run it on the whole survey, after the per-file fan-in. Active criteria each give a cut and the shallowest wins.

inputs.name: ds_Sv
inputs.description: Survey Sv Dataset to crop, normally after apply_sv_mask so the seafloor returns are already NaN.

params.name: max_range_m
params.description: Hard cap on range. Samples deeper than this are dropped whether or not they hold data. Unset derives the crop from the data.

params.name: outlier_sigma
params.description: Standard deviations above the mean of each ping's deepest finite sample at which a ping counts as an outlier and is ignored. Unset disables outlier rejection and uses drop_trailing_all_nan.

params.name: outlier_margin
params.description: Multiplier on (mean + outlier_sigma x sd) giving the outlier threshold. Raise it to flag fewer pings. Only used when outlier_sigma is set.

params.name: drop_trailing_all_nan
params.description: Crop to one past the deepest sample with a finite value anywhere (lossless). Ignored when outlier_sigma is set. False, with the other two unset, turns the step into a no-op.

params.name: data_var
params.description: Variable inspected for finite values.

params.name: range_var
params.description: Variable supplying each sample's range in metres.

outputs.name: ds_Sv
outputs.description: The same Dataset with the trailing empty range samples dropped.

nodes.description: Add split-beam ``angle_alongship`` and ``angle_athwartship`` variables to an Sv Dataset using echopype. Needed before the "blackwell" and phase seafloor detectors.

inputs.name: ds_Sv
inputs.description: Calibrated Sv dataset, typically after ``ep_add_depth``.

inputs.name: echodata
inputs.description: Source EchoData object containing split-beam samples.

params.name: waveform_mode
params.description: Transmit waveform mode. Use ``CW`` for narrowband EK60/EK80 power/angle data, or ``BB`` for broadband complex samples.

params.name: encode_mode
params.description: Return echo encoding mode. Use ``power`` for EK60/EK80 power/angle data, or ``complex`` for complex samples.

params.name: pulse_compression
params.description: Whether to pulse-compress broadband complex samples. Only valid for ``waveform_mode: BB`` and ``encode_mode: complex``.

params.name: to_disk
params.description: Write split-beam angles back to disk when ``ds_Sv`` is a path. Keep false for in-memory recipe execution.

params.name: drop_last_hanning_zero
params.description: Echopype compatibility option for broadband pulse compression. Usually leave false.

outputs.name: ds_Sv
outputs.description: Input Sv dataset with ``angle_alongship`` and ``angle_athwartship`` variables added.

nodes.description: Trim the deep range samples that hold no data after seafloor masking. Run it on the whole survey, after the per-file fan-in. Active criteria each give a cut and the shallowest wins.

inputs.name: ds_Sv
inputs.description: Survey Sv Dataset to crop, normally after apply_sv_mask so the seafloor returns are already NaN.

params.name: max_range_m
params.description: Hard cap on range. Samples deeper than this are dropped whether or not they hold data. Unset derives the crop from the data.

params.name: outlier_sigma
params.description: Standard deviations above the mean of each ping's deepest finite sample at which a ping counts as an outlier and is ignored. Unset disables outlier rejection and uses drop_trailing_all_nan.

params.name: outlier_margin
params.description: Multiplier on (mean + outlier_sigma x sd) giving the outlier threshold. Raise it to flag fewer pings. Only used when outlier_sigma is set.

params.name: drop_trailing_all_nan
params.description: Crop to one past the deepest sample with a finite value anywhere (lossless). Ignored when outlier_sigma is set. False, with the other two unset, turns the step into a no-op.

params.name: data_var
params.description: Variable inspected for finite values.

params.name: range_var
params.description: Variable supplying each sample's range in metres.

outputs.name: ds_Sv
outputs.description: The same Dataset with the trailing empty range samples dropped.

nodes.description: Detect the seafloor from Sv and split-beam phase, returning the seabed echo's leading edge in metres per ping. Swaps in for the other seafloor ops, so ``create_seafloor_mask`` works unchanged; put any dead-zone offset in its ``seafloor_buffer_m``.

inputs.name: ds_Sv
inputs.description: Calibrated Sv dataset, ideally from ``ep_add_splitbeam_angle`` so depth and phase are available. Without ``depth`` the line is measured from the transducer.

inputs.name: echodata
inputs.description: Accepted for interface parity with the other seafloor detection ops; not read.

inputs.name: z_prior
inputs.description: Optional expected seabed depth per ping, such as another detector's line, on any ping grid. Sets the search window to z_prior +/- 3 sigma_prior_m, overriding r_min and r_max where they conflict.

params.name: channel
params.description: Primary channel, as its label or its frequency in Hz or kHz as a string (e.g. "38"). Null picks the lowest frequency with enough seabed seeds.

params.name: r_min
params.description: Lower bound of the search window on the dataset's range reference. Default 10 m past the first sample, which skips the transmit pulse.

params.name: r_max
params.description: Upper bound of the search window. Default the end of the channel's range. Set both bounds on deep surveys to keep the run fast.

params.name: sigma_prior_m
params.description: Uncertainty of z_prior; default 2 % of z_prior. Ignored without it.

params.name: regime
params.description: Depth regime preset: "shelf" (< 200 m), "slope" (200 to 1000 m), "deep" (> 1000 m) or "auto" from the search window midpoint. Sets the SNR reference, the seed Sv floor and the Mode 2 shape window.

params.name: mode
params.description: Scoring mode. 1 scores the six point features; 2 adds three local shape features, a little slower, which help where a school sits on the bottom.

params.name: line
params.description: Line to return: "leading_edge" (default), the start of the seabed echo, or "integration", the backstepped line with slope correction.

params.name: prior
params.description: "auto" (default) runs the Mode 0 slab estimator when no z_prior is given and uses it as the search window; "none" searches only the fixed r_min / r_max window.

params.name: missing
params.description: Value for pings with no seabed found after gap filling. "nan" (default) masks the whole ping downstream, for analysis. "max_range" uses the last recorded range, keeping the ping for survey pictures.

params.name: min_seabed_sv_db
params.description: Minimum mean Sv over one pulse length below a pick for it to count as seabed. Null disables the check.

params.name: prior_budget
params.description: Number of slabs (small groups of pings) the prior estimator reads.

params.name: n_candidates
params.description: Score maxima kept per ping for the line search.

params.name: max_slope_deg
params.description: Maximum plausible seabed slope; larger depth jumps between pings are penalized. Use 45 on rocky or canyon terrain.

params.name: alpha
params.description: Transition strength multiplier in [0.5, 2].

params.name: beta_fraction
params.description: Shallow-first tie-break prior as a fraction of the candidate score spread; 0 disables it. Targets ghost bottoms and the echo tail.

params.name: min_score
params.description: Candidates below this score are dropped; a ping with none is skipped and bridged. Scores are sums of tanh terms, so 0 means neutral.

params.name: walkback_db
params.description: Drop below the echo peak that marks the leading edge.

params.name: effective_beamwidth_deg
params.description: Effective beamwidth for the backstepped integration line in the diagnostics; default nominal times 12/7 (the ES38B ratio).

params.name: vessel_speed_m_s
params.description: Vessel speed for along-track distance when ds_Sv has no latitude and longitude. Set it for transects without position data.

params.name: min_confidence
params.description: Pings whose posterior confidence is below this are flagged.

params.name: phase_weight
params.description: Weight of the two phase features. Raise to 1.5 where fish aggregations are the main confuser.

params.name: max_gap_s
params.description: Interior runs of skipped pings up to this long are interpolated; longer runs stay NaN. Null interpolates nothing.

params.name: transition
params.description: "huber" or "truncated" (quadratic capped at the break-point, for cliffs).

params.name: pulse_length_s
params.description: Pulse duration when ds_Sv has no tau_effective.

params.name: beamwidth_deg
params.description: Nominal beamwidth when ds_Sv has none.

params.name: detect_aliases
params.description: Detect aliased seabed echoes on the primary channel and exclude them. Off by default; it can mask the true seabed in noisy water.

params.name: phase_threshold_deg2
params.description: Seed phase-stability threshold on the summed angle variance within one pulse length; default (beamwidth / 2)^2.

params.name: confidence_tolerance_pulses
params.description: Alternatives within this many pulse lengths of the pick (plus the beam-geometry spread, or inside the same loud run) count as the same pick when computing confidence and margin.

params.name: diagnostics_path
params.description: Optional zarr path for the full diagnostics (features, scores, candidates, lines, confidence and flags). Local runs only.

outputs.name: seafloor_depth
outputs.description: Seabed leading edge in metres on ds_Sv's ping_time. Attributes record the vertical reference, channel, regime, ping coverage and the counts of flagged and interpolated pings.

nodes.description: Build a seafloor mask from baseline Sv and detected seafloor depth. The seafloor depth is passed as an explicit input, enabling swappable detection methods without modifying masking logic.

inputs.name: ds_Sv
inputs.description: Sv Dataset the mask is shaped to. Supplies the meter-valued range variable that each sample's depth is compared against.

inputs.name: seafloor_depth
inputs.description: Seafloor depth per ping from any seafloor detection op. Pings where it is NaN are masked entirely rather than guessed at.

params.name: seafloor_buffer_m
params.description: Height above the seafloor line to also mask, covering detection error and the near-bottom dead zone at the cost of some real backscatter.

params.name: range_var
params.description: Meter-valued variable on ds_Sv compared against the seafloor line, on the same vertical reference. Null (default) uses "depth" if present, otherwise "echo_range".

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: Boolean DataArray shaped like ds_Sv['Sv']; True means valid data (above seafloor)

nodes.description: Build a surface-interference mask from baseline Sv using a selectable method.

inputs.name: ds_Sv
inputs.description: Sv Dataset the mask is shaped to. Supplies the range variable each sample's depth is read from.

params.name: surface_depth_m
params.description: Depth above which samples are masked out, removing the transmit pulse ringdown and near-surface bubble layer. The default of 0.0 masks nothing.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: Boolean mask DataArray; True means valid data

nodes.description: Build a mask that excludes selected frequency channels. Implementation can be swapped to use different exclusion criteria.

inputs.name: ds_Sv
inputs.description: Sv Dataset the mask is shaped to. Supplies the nominal channel frequencies matched against frequencies_to_mask.

params.name: frequencies_to_mask
params.description: Nominal channel frequencies to exclude, in kHz (e.g. [70, 120, 200]). Every sample on a listed channel is marked invalid. The default empty list masks nothing.

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: Boolean mask DataArray; True means valid data

nodes.description: Combine two or more mask datasets into one final mask. Accepts a list of mask inputs to support inserting additional custom mask-producing steps into the chain without changing core framework code.

inputs.name: masks
inputs.description: List of boolean mask DataArrays to combine

params.name: mode
params.description: Combination mode: 'and' (all must be valid) or 'or' (any must be valid)

outputs.name: mask
outputs.description: Combined boolean mask DataArray

nodes.description: Apply a boolean mask to an Sv Dataset, setting masked samples to NaN.

inputs.name: ds_Sv
inputs.description: Sv Dataset to mask, normally straight from compute_sv.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: Boolean mask broadcastable against ds_Sv["Sv"], where True marks a sample to keep. Normally the single mask from combine_masks, so every exclusion rule the recipe built is applied in one pass.

outputs.name: ds_Sv
outputs.description: Sv Dataset with masked samples set to NaN

nodes.description: Estimate and remove background noise from Sv using the De Robertis and Higginbottom method. Returns a cleaned Sv Dataset whose Sv holds the corrected values.

inputs.name: ds_Sv
inputs.description: Sv Dataset to denoise, normally the masked Sv from apply_sv_mask so the seafloor and surface returns are not folded into the noise estimate.

params.name: ping_num
params.description: Number of pings used to estimate the noise level

params.name: range_sample_num
params.description: Number of range samples used to estimate the noise level

params.name: background_noise_max
params.description: Upper limit on the estimated noise level (e.g. '-125dB'); omit to leave it unbounded

params.name: SNR_threshold
params.description: Signal-to-noise ratio below which corrected samples are masked out (e.g. '3.0dB')

outputs.name: ds_Sv
outputs.description: Noise-corrected Sv Dataset

nodes.description: Remove spatiotemporal bins with fewer valid samples than a threshold, reducing noise in MVBS computation.

inputs.name: ds_Sv
inputs.description: Sv Dataset to screen, normally the masked, noise-removed Sv from remove_background_noise.

params.name: range_bin
params.description: Range bin size (e.g. '2m')

params.name: ping_time_bin
params.description: Ping-time bin size (e.g. '10s')

params.name: nan_threshold
params.description: Fraction of NaN values above which a bin is masked (0.0 to 1.0)

params.name: range_var
params.description: Meter-valued variable to bin along: 'echo_range' (from the transducer face) or 'depth' (from the surface; the dataset must carry depth). Must match compute_mvbs and compute_per_cell_statistics.

outputs.name: ds_Sv
outputs.description: The same Dataset with samples in under-populated bins set to NaN. Feed this to compute_mvbs using the same bin sizes.

nodes.description: Compute Mean Volume Backscattering Strength by averaging Sv over range and time bins. Returns a gridded MVBS Dataset.

inputs.name: ds_Sv
inputs.description: Cleaned Sv Dataset to average, normally from mask_sparse_bins so sparse bins are already NaN and do not pull the means toward the noise floor.

params.name: range_bin
params.description: Depth bin size for averaging (e.g. '2m')

params.name: ping_time_bin
params.description: Ping-time bin size for averaging (e.g. '10s')

params.name: range_var
params.description: Meter-valued variable to bin along: 'echo_range' (from the transducer face) or 'depth' (from the surface; the dataset must carry depth, which ep_add_depth adds).

params.name: range_var_max
params.description: Deepest value the bins cover, as a unit string (e.g. '2100m'). Unset reads the maximum from the data; supplying it keeps the step lazy.

params.name: closed
params.description: Which side of each bin interval is closed: 'left' or 'right'

params.name: skipna
params.description: Skip NaN values when averaging. When false, any NaN in a bin makes the whole bin NaN, so masked data collapses.

params.name: fill_value
params.description: Value for bins holding no data. Unset keeps echopype's default, NaN.

params.name: method
params.description: Flox reduction strategy for dask arrays, normally 'map-reduce'. Any other value needs reindex set to null in the same params block.

params.name: reindex
params.description: Reindex at the blockwise stage rather than after it. False uses less memory and more time. Only meaningful when method is 'map-reduce'.

outputs.name: ds_MVBS
outputs.description: Gridded MVBS Dataset

nodes.description: Concatenate a collected list of Datasets into one along ``dim``, for example per-file MVBS gathered with ``collect``. A single Dataset passes through unchanged.

inputs.name: datasets
inputs.description: Collected list of Datasets, one per mapped or swept instance, supplied by ``collect: ${mapped_step.output}`` on the recipe step.

params.name: dim
params.description: Dimension to concatenate the collected Datasets along.

params.name: on_duplicate
params.description: How to handle two collected segments with the same label on ``dim``. Unset keeps both (fine when segments can't overlap). "mean" averages them (binned products split at a segment boundary). "first" keeps the first and sorts (overlapping slices of one store).

outputs.name: merged
outputs.description: The concatenated result: a Dataset for collected Datasets, a DataArray for collected DataArrays (such as per-file seafloor lines).

nodes.description: Rechunk a Dataset along ping_time so the steps after it can run dask-parallel.

inputs.name: ds_Sv
inputs.description: Dataset to rechunk. Any Sv-like Dataset is accepted, whatever step produced it.

params.name: ping_time_chunk
params.description: Target chunk size along ping_time.

outputs.name: ds_Sv
outputs.description: The same Dataset backed by dask arrays chunked along ping_time, so the steps wired after it can run chunk-parallel.

nodes.description: Choose ping ranges that a pyramid can be built over independently and then concatenated exactly. Every range but the last is a multiple of 2**(levels-1) pings.

inputs.name: ds_Sv
inputs.description: Sv Dataset, read only for its ping count.

params.name: levels
params.description: Levels the build will produce, which is what sets the grid.

params.name: target_pings
params.description: Rough segment size in pings, rounded down onto the grid. Raise it for a machine with more memory, lower it for a deep water column.

outputs.name: ranges
outputs.description: List of [start, stop] ping ranges, in order and tiling the survey with no gap or overlap. Map build_echogram_pyramid over this.

outputs.name: grid
outputs.description: The multiple the ranges are aligned to, which is 2**(levels-1).

nodes.description: Build a level-of-detail pyramid from an Sv Dataset for the WebGPU echogram viewer, where level k merges 2**k pings. `aa-echogram serve --store <path>` reads a checkpointed pyramid straight from the cache.

inputs.name: ds_Sv
inputs.description: Sv Dataset with a vertical coordinate and ping_time. Normally the output of apply_sv_mask or remove_noise, or the merged survey Sv from a segment-parallel chain.

params.name: levels
params.description: Levels to build, halving the ping axis each time. Eight levels reduce the ping axis by 128 at the coarsest.

params.name: range_var
params.description: Vertical coordinate to build the geometry from. Use echo_range, not depth; the surface reference is kept as a per ping transducer depth.

params.name: ping_range
params.description: Optional [start, stop] naming one segment of the ping axis. Supplied by a mapped step as ${_item} from plan_pyramid_segments.

params.name: aggregation
params.description: How pings are merged: 'linear_mean' averages in linear space and reports decibels (right for biomass); 'max' keeps the loudest sample, preserving a single strong target.

outputs.name: pyramid
outputs.description: DataTree with one node per level, carrying the multiscales block and the per chunk summaries on its root attributes.

nodes.description: Collect per segment pyramids into one, level by level. Only correct when the parts were cut by plan_pyramid_segments.

inputs.name: parts
inputs.description: Collected pyramid DataTrees, in ping order, supplied by a ``collect: ${mapped_step.pyramid}`` directive.

params.name: dim
params.description: Ping dimension to concatenate along.

outputs.name: pyramid
outputs.description: The combined pyramid, as one DataTree with a node per level.

groups.label: Runs once per item of query_ncei.raw_urls
Runs once per item of query_ncei.raw_urls
Runs once per item of plan_segments.ranges

includes.name: hb1603_processing_lvl_0_user
includes.title: hb1603_processing_lvl_0_user
includes.description: The survey's catalogue and calibration mapping, loaded from the cache and never regenerated.

inputs.name: cruise_name
inputs.description: Cruise name searched for in the NCEI catalogue, such as "HB1603".

inputs.name: file_time_start
inputs.description: Start of the NCEI catalogue query, an inclusive ISO UTC datetime such as "2016-07-25T20:58". Every file overlapping the window is fetched.

inputs.name: file_time_end
inputs.description: End of the NCEI catalogue query, an inclusive ISO UTC datetime such as "2016-07-25T21:45". Every file overlapping the window is fetched.

inputs.name: cal_input_folder
inputs.description: Folder of manufacturer calibration files (.cal for EK60, .xml for EK80), a local path or a gs:// URL.

inputs.name: calibration_output_dir
inputs.description: Root folder the calibration artifacts are written under.

inputs.name: cruise_id
inputs.description: Cruise identifier, such as "HB1603", recorded in every generated single-channel calibration file so it stays traceable to the survey.

inputs.name: record_author
inputs.description: Name recorded as the author of every generated single-channel calibration file.

inputs.name: max_scan_bytes
inputs.description: Most leading bytes read from each raw file to find its channel configuration. The default, 1 MiB, settles every HB1603 file in one small read.

inputs.name: match_tolerances
inputs.description: Per-field tolerances for matching a raw channel to a calibration file (Hz, W, or s), merged over exact defaults. The default widens transmit_power to 1001 W.

includes.name: hb1603_processing_lvl_1_per_file
includes.title: hb1603_processing_lvl_1_per_file
includes.description: Per-file raw ingest, streamed from NCEI.

inputs.name: per_file_source
inputs.description: The step output list the per-file steps map over, one instance per entry, normally ${query_ncei.raw_urls}. Required; give every level in the chain the same value.

inputs.name: sonar_model
inputs.description: Echosounder model as echopype names it, such as "EK60" or "EK80".

includes.name: hb1603_processing_lvl_2_survey
includes.title: hb1603_processing_lvl_2_survey
includes.description: Per-file Sv with surface-referenced depth, cropped. The shared survey artifact.

inputs.name: per_file_source
inputs.description: The step output list the per-file steps map over, one instance per entry, normally ${query_ncei.raw_urls}. Required; give every level in the chain the same value.

inputs.name: calibration_dict
inputs.description: Standardized calibration values keyed by calibration key, from the calibration mapping step.

inputs.name: mapping_dict
inputs.description: Mapping from each raw file's channels to their calibration key, from the calibration mapping step.

inputs.name: crop_max_range_m
inputs.description: Range ceiling in metres; samples beyond it are dropped even if they hold data. Changing it recomputes the whole survey Sv.

includes.name: hb1603_processing_lvl_2_viewer_seabed
includes.title: hb1603_processing_lvl_2_viewer_seabed
includes.description: Per file, the whole survey: split-beam angles, phase-aware seabed line, surface, frequency and seabed masks, then noise removal.

inputs.name: crop_max_range_m
inputs.description: Range ceiling in metres, applied after the split-beam angles are added; samples beyond it are dropped even if they hold data. Level 3's grid_max_depth must reach it.

inputs.name: seabed_channel
inputs.description: Channel the seabed is picked on, as a channel label or a frequency in kHz such as "38". 38 kHz reaches the bottom everywhere on HB1603.

inputs.name: seabed_max_slope_deg
inputs.description: Maximum plausible seabed slope, in degrees; with the distance between pings it sets how far the line may move per ping at ordinary cost. Use 45 for canyon terrain.

inputs.name: seabed_max_gap_s
inputs.description: Interior gaps in the detected seabed line up to this many seconds are interpolated. Longer gaps, and the ends of a file, follow the missing-seabed setting.

inputs.name: seafloor_buffer_m
inputs.description: Height above the seabed line, in metres, that is also masked, to drop the bottom echo and detection error.

inputs.name: seabed_line
inputs.description: "leading_edge" masks from the top of the seabed echo; "integration" masks from the slope-corrected line above it, which clears more on steep walls.

inputs.name: surface_depth_m
inputs.description: Range from the transducer, in metres, above which samples are masked, to remove the transmit pulse and ringdown.

inputs.name: frequencies_to_mask
inputs.description: Nominal channel frequencies in kHz to blank, such as [70, 120, 200]; every sample on those channels is masked. An empty list keeps every channel.

inputs.name: noise_range_sample_num
inputs.description: Range samples per bin for the background noise estimate.

inputs.name: noise_ping_num
inputs.description: Pings per bin for the background noise estimate.

inputs.name: noise_snr_threshold
inputs.description: Samples whose noise-corrected Sv is less than this above the noise estimate are masked, as a dB string such as "3.0dB". Raise it for a cleaner, shallower picture.

inputs.name: noise_background_max
inputs.description: Ceiling on the background noise estimate, as a dB string such as "-125dB". Null leaves it unbounded.

includes.name: hb1603_processing_lvl_3_viewer
includes.title: hb1603_processing_lvl_3_viewer
includes.description: Per-file sparse masking and MVBS on a pinned depth grid, fanned in to one survey-wide store.

inputs.name: range_bin
inputs.description: Depth bin height of the MVBS grid, as a length string such as "2m". The sparse-bin mask uses the same bin.

inputs.name: ping_time_bin
inputs.description: Ping-time bin width of the MVBS grid, as a duration string such as "10s". The sparse-bin mask uses the same bin.

inputs.name: range_var
inputs.description: Variable the bins are built on: "depth" (below the surface, shared across files and channels) or "echo_range" (from the transducer face). Keep "depth" to layer this store with the analysis store.

inputs.name: grid_max_depth
inputs.description: Deepest depth the bins cover, such as "1810m", pinned so every file shares one axis. It must clear the range crop plus the transducer depth; deeper samples are dropped.

inputs.name: nan_threshold
inputs.description: Fraction of NaN samples (0 to 1) above which the sparse-bin mask drops a bin.

inputs.name: viewer_chunk_ping_time
inputs.description: Ping-time chunk size of the survey MVBS store; the pyramid build reads it in segments, so a few chunks per segment suits it.

includes.name: hb1603_viewer_pyramid
includes.title: hb1603_viewer_pyramid
includes.description: Build a gridded Sv store into an EchogramGL pyramid, segment-parallel.

inputs.name: gridded_sv
inputs.description: Sv on one shared grid with a one dimensional vertical coordinate, such as the survey MVBS store.

inputs.name: pyramid_range_var
inputs.description: Vertical coordinate of the pyramid store: "depth" for a gridded product, "echo_range" for full-resolution Sv, where depth carries heave.

inputs.name: pyramid_levels
inputs.description: Pyramid levels to build, halving the column axis each time; eight reduce it by 128 at the coarsest.

inputs.name: pyramid_segment_columns
inputs.description: Rough segment size in columns, rounded down onto the pyramid's grid. Each segment is held in memory while it builds, about 1.7 GiB at the default.

inputs.name: pyramid_aggregation
inputs.description: How columns are merged: "linear_mean" averages in linear space, right for biomass; "max" keeps a single strong target a mean would dilute.
